thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: multigpu-collective-latency-spike detected on cluster-gamma. Severity: P1. Affected service: inference-runtime. Link: https://incidents.internal/4123456999

Sara: seeing huge tail latency on several TP4 jobs, looks like NCCL collectives stalling then recovering repeatedly. Customer visible errors (some Dedicated tenants) — elevated 95/99th token latency.

Aj: confirmed. Logs show repeated `NCCL WARN` + `comm reset` around t=4123456930-4123456990. Also intermittent CUDA Xid 79 on node-gpu-12.

Mike: oncall checking node health now, pinging eng-runtime.

Lucy: @oncall (aj) please call bridge if not already. We should do immediate mitigation: cordon node-gpu-12, scale down TP4 pods on that host, and switch routing policy to fallback single-GPU variant for impacted model ids.

Aj: joining bridge: /call incident-4123456999 (bridge created)

ops-bot: Bridge started: https://meet.internal/bridge/4123456999 - participants: aj, sara, mike, lucy, carlos

Carlos: I see node-gpu-12 has repeated `nvlink` errors and `nvidia-mig` reports unstable. `dmesg` shows frequent `Xid 79: GPU hang` on GPU0 then driver resets.

Sara: timeline from tracing: 4123456910 first token latency spike -> 4123456930 first NCCL WARN -> 4123456948 short recovery -> 4123456965 full stall -> 4123456990 partial recovery. Customer graphs show retries / 502s during the stall window.

Aj: quick mitigations in order: 1) cordon node-gpu-12 2) gracefully drain TP4 pods from node 3) enable fallback routing to single-gpu-quantized-variant for model: rwd-model-bert-3 4) temporary autoscale up on dedicated pool gamma-2 to absorb load.

Mike: doing cordon now: ```kubectl cordon node-gpu-12``` -> `node/gpu-12 cordoned`

Mike: draining TP4 pods (graceful, 60s): ```kubectl drain node-gpu-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force --grace-period=60```

Carlos: I kicked a restart of `nvidia-driver` on node-gpu-12 shell, but driver resets are risky. Going safe route: leave node cordoned and let infra-team reprovision.

Sara: routing change executed: hit routing service to set fallback policy for rwd-model-bert-3 to single-gpu-quantized-variant with canary=false. Commands: ```POST /v1/routing/policy {"model":"rwd-model-bert-3","policy":"fallback","target":"single-gpu-quantized-variant"}``` -> OK 200.

Aj: autoscale request sent to Dedicated: `increase pool gamma-2 by +3 instances, reason: incident 4123456999`

ops-bot: Dedicated autoscale accepted, expected capacity add within 2 min.

Lucy: customer impact note: ~4 Dedicated tenants saw failed inference requests during 4123456940-4123456990. Some requests retried and succeeded; a small fraction (~0.8%) returned 502s. Need customer comms if SLA thresholds hit.

Sara: collecting logs from runtime: paste of the key snippet: ```[4123456937] NCCL WARN comm 0x7f8a: recv timeout on rank 2
[4123456941] NCCL INFO communicator reset attempt 1
[4123456950] CUDA ERROR Xid 79 on GPU0 -> driver reset invoked
[4123456955] nccl: allreduce returned -2
[4123456966] pods restarted due to liveness probe fail```

Carlos: also saw `rccl` style pairing issue on one job (pipeline parallel + tensor parallel combined), leader election oscillating between ranks 1 and 3, causing repeated re-syncs. Likely flaky NIC on node-gpu-12.

Aj: remediation checklist: 1) cordon+drain (done) 2) route traffic away (done) 3) force-restart affected containers in cluster for clean KV cache 4) eta for capacity from Dedicated ~2m 5) open internal bug and assign to eng-runtime for deeper RCA and driver trace

Mike: forcing restart of affected pods cluster-wide for that model group: ```kubectl rollout restart deployment/rwd-runtime-bert-3 -n inference``` -> started, pods coming up.

Sara: monitor: dashboards show 95th latency back to normal after routing change and pod restart, but we still see occasional NCCL WARNs in logs from other nodes (likely cascaded).

Aj: assigning follow-up: eng-runtime (owner: sara), eng-infra (owner: carlos). Filed ticket INT-4123456999 with logs and kernel dumps. Linked: https://tickets.internal/INT-4123456999

Lucy: customer-facing note draft: "We observed a service degradation for a subset of inference requests caused by multi-GPU collective instability related to NCCL communicator resets on one GPU node. We mitigated impact by routing traffic to fallback variants and scaling capacity. We're investigating root cause and will follow up." Approve?

Sara: LGTM, please send to affected customers after we confirm full recovery window (waiting 15m). Add apology and offer 99.9% credit if SLA breached.

Aj: oncall handoff update: switching to secondary oncall @mike in 25m, I will leave a detailed runbook in the ticket.

ops-bot: Incident status: mitigated -> partial mitigation in place. Monitoring for 30m.

Mike: follow-up actions for RCA: collect `nvidia-smi -q -d MEMORY,ACCEL` dumps, driver log from /var/log/nvidia, full NCCL debug logs with env `NCCL_DEBUG=INFO` for repro job, and NIC counters (ethtool). Carlos please coordinate with infra to repro in a fenced environment.

Carlos: will repro on staging with the same tp/pp config and force NIC flakiness via `tc qdisc` to see if we can induce leader oscillation.

Sara: tagging eng-ml for model-level check: @eng-ml are there any recent changes to the TP/PP partitioning or KV cache that could interact badly with collectives?

ops-bot: Reminder: add incident postmortem template to ticket and assign owners for timeline, root cause, and customer impact sections.

Aj: closing notes: customers impacted transiently, mitigations applied (cordon/drain + routing fallback + autoscale + pod restarts), monitoring flags green for last 3m. Leaving incident open for RCA; next update in 30m.

Mike: thanks all. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident updated: status=monitoring, severity=P1, incident_owner=aj, link=https://incidents.internal/4123456999/summary

Sara: adding small note — check KV cache consistency for models that resumed on single GPU, some prompts might have degraded perf. Will run eval set after full rollout.

Carlos: note to infra: decommission node-gpu-12 for hardware triage after drain completes.

Mike: acknowledged. We'll schedule node replacement.

Aj: last: anyone seeing more 502s? If not, we'll do customer comms in 20m.

Sara: none after routing change, spike window closed.

ops-bot: Incident will be transitioned to Postmortem state after RCA ticket updated.
